question: Where can I get a list of desalination plants in Spain, with location, capacity, technology, operator and status?

answer.summary: No official national list of desalination plants was found. The best single source is the EMODnet WFS (GWI DesalData, CC-BY): 1143 Spanish rows with municipality-level position, capacity m3/d, technology, owner and status, but a 2020-21 snapshot and 21% of rows pinned to Madrid. AEDyR 2024 tables give the 88 plants above 10,000 m3/d. Exact data from owners exist only for Baleares (8 IDAM), MCT and ACUAMED pages.
main_caveats: EMODnet rows are units or projects, not plants: 1143 rows for 159 location IDs, 129 duplicate keys, and 232 rows are wastewater-fed reuse plants, not seawater or brackish desalination.
Positions are municipality centroids; 235 of 1143 Spanish rows (20.6%) sit on the Madrid centroid because GWI coordinates were judged inaccurate. Do not measure distances from them.
Data are dated: EMODnet rows last updated up to 2021-03-27 (Aguilas 180,000 m3/d vs 210,000 in AEDyR 2024). Status values Presumed Online/Offline are unconfirmed.
Plant counts disagree: AEDyR more than 765 plants >100 m3/d, MITECO PDF more than 900 (undated), SINAC 2024 328 ETAP of type desaladora, EMODnet 159 locations.
AEDyR lists only plants above 10,000 m3/d (about 77% of national capacity by its own estimate) and carries no operator, technology, status or coordinates.
answer.confidence_reason: Numbers measured from live services and opened pages; negatives rest on opened official pages but regional bodies of Canarias, Valencia, Murcia and Cataluña (capacity) were only partly opened.

attributes.note: EMODnet municipality centroid (235 rows at Madrid); exact only for 8 Balearic IDAM and 14 OSM features.
attributes.gap_note: No national layer with exact plant positions found; IDE catalogues searched (IDEE CSW, IDEAndalucia, IDEIB).

attributes.note: m3/day in EMODnet (1132 of 1143 rows) and AEDyR; hm3/year in ACUAMED and CHS pages. Dates 2021 and 2024.
EMODnet technology filled in 1001 of 1143 rows (RO 819, MED 66, ED 60); MCT pages state reverse osmosis.
attributes.gap_note: AEDyR, MITECO and regional layers give no technology; no list of the remaining plants found.

attributes.gap_note: No registry of operators found in MITECO, ACUAMED, MCT, CHS or AEDyR pages; contracts sit in procurement portals (not opened).

attributes.gap_note: No current official status register found; MITECO/ACUAMED pages cover single plants only.

how_to_use.example_result: 1143 features (5.26 MB GeoJSON). First Torrevieja query (same URL with AND location='Torrevieja'&count=2): {"coordinates":[-0.683333,37.983333],"objectid":"ES173","location":"Torrevieja","project":"Murcia/Almeria","capacity_m3d":"1220","technology":"RO (Reverse Osmosis)","feedwater":"Seawater (TDS 20000ppm - 50000ppm)","plant_status":"Online","online_date":"2008","plant_owner":""}. Torrevieja SWRO row: capacity 240000, plant_owner "Acuamed", online 2013, status Online.
steps: Count first: same URL with resultType=hits instead of outputFormat (numberMatched="1143" for Spain on 2026-11-16).
Download with cql_filter=country='Spain' and count=5000; load GeoJSON; properties are strings, cast capacity_m3d to number.
Drop rows with feedwater=Wastewater (reuse/tertiary RO at sewage plants, 232 rows) unless reuse is wanted; keep Seawater and Brackish for desalination proper.
Group by objectid + project to merge unit rows; remove exact duplicates (129 repeated objectid/project/capacity keys).
Treat plant_status Presumed Online/Offline as unconfirmed; use online_date and last_update to judge age.
Do not trust geometry for rows with location=Madrid or accuracy=ESTIMATED; use name and region instead.
reading_traps: 235 of 1143 Spanish rows (20.6%) have location=Madrid and sit on the Madrid centroid (-3.696, 40.465); 207 are ESTIMATED. The dictionary says inaccurate coordinates were moved to the capital or county seat. Examples: Marina Baja (Alicante) 50000 m3/d, Almunecar (Granada).
A row is a unit/project, not a plant: 1143 rows for 159 location IDs; objectid ES173 (Torrevieja) groups 6 rows from 500 to 240000 m3/d. Summing rows overcounts duplicates.

Online capacity summed over all Spanish rows is 11.16 million m3/d, but 6.15 million of that is wastewater-fed; seawater 3.39 and brackish 1.08 million m3/d. AEDyR cites about 5 million m3/d for the country.
Data are a 2020-2021 snapshot (max last_update 2021-03-27): Aguilas Guadalentin shows 180000 m3/d, AEDyR 2024 lists 210000; Torrevieja expansion appears as 120000 Construction.
The metadata zip documents ~30 fields but the live WFS exposes ~180 columns (RO/MED design, suppliers, developers); most are blank for Spain.
Field values are strings; empty string means unknown, not zero.

recipe: Start from an EMODnet or AEDyR plant name and municipality.
Open the MITECO viability-report page for the demarcation and download the plant PDF (Torrevieja example: 21 pages, 1.0 MB, text-based).
Run pdftotext -layout and grep "hm3/año|m3/d|capacidad|explotación|ósmosis": capacity and start date are in the introduction (p.4), technology in the works description (p.11).
Check units: reports use hm3/year; divide by 0.365 for m3/day (80 hm3/y = about 219,000 m3/d, while MITECO PDF cites 240,000 m3/d for the same plant).
Take the owner/operator from the "Organismo que presenta el Informe" field (ACUAMED) or from the operator page (MCT).
Add ACUAMED/MCT ficha status text (Explotación) and cross-check with EMODnet plant_status.
For allocation or operator context search the BOE (Sección V-B) for the plant name and read the anuncio: it gives intake point, volume in hm3/year and the body that processes the concession.
if_unstructured.location_method: The viability report places works in the municipality and the plant parcel without coordinates; for exact position use the Baleares REST layer, OSM, the PNOA orthophoto, or the cadastre parcel inside the municipality named in the report.

where_published.name: CHS Segura - desalinizacion page (plan hidrologico table)
where_published.what: Plant outputs per horizon for the Segura basin from the hydrological plan 2015-2021.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Single page; table by plant; the plan itself (BOE) is the source and is not linked.

example_document.what_it_gives: Rows such as "Águilas ACUAMED | 34 | 48 | 48" hm3/year (irrigation, 2015/2021/2027) and Valdelentisco 27 / 37 / 37; headline "desalinated resources in the demarcation would reach 158 hm³ / year".

where_published.name: BOE Seccion V-B (Anuncios oficiales) - concessions and project competitions on desalination plants
where_published.what: Official notices from basin authorities and MITECO on water concessions drawn from named desalination plants (volume, intake point, municipality).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE text search (Buscar en el BOE) by title word desaladora/desalinizadora/IDAM; open data API at /datosabiertos/api/api.php. The GET form tried returned no hit list to a script, so search from the web form.

example_document.what_it_gives: BOE núm. 20, 23-01-2024, pág. 3388, anuncio 2275 (CHS): "Volumen de agua a asignar: 20 hm³/año."; "Punto de toma: IDAM de Torrevieja T.M. Torrevieja (Alicante)."; "Para la disponibilidad de la totalidad de este volumen es necesario que esté ejecutada la ampliación de la desaladora hasta los 120 Hm³ anuales."

open_questions: Torrevieja capacity differs by source: MITECO viability report says 80 hm3/year (about 219,000 m3/d) while a MITECO PDF and AEDyR say 240,000 m3/d; only ACUAMED can say which is design and which nominal.
EMODnet shows 159 location IDs while AEDyR counts more than 765 plants above 100 m3/d: whether EMODnet is incomplete or counts sites differently cannot be settled from the open data.

history.note: No official national list found; best structured source is EMODnet (GWI DesalData, 2021) with 1143 Spanish rows; AEDyR 2024 tables give 88 large plants.
